before.name: Felice Cohen-Joppa
before.description: Felice Cohen-Joppa, born June 26, 1959, co-founded The Nuclear Resister with Jack Cohen-Joppa in 1980 and has spent decades documenting arrests and supporting imprisoned anti-nuclear and anti-war activists. Tucson police arrested her and five others at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base on March 1, 1998; the court imposed probation and community service rather than jail. Washington police arrested her again at the Israeli Embassy on September 28, 2000 during a protest marking Mordechai Vanunu’s imprisonment. She was held overnight and released the following day.

before.name: Jack Cohen-Joppa
before.description: Co-founder and co-publisher (with wife Felice) of The Nuclear Resister newsletter, which since 1980 has chronicled and supported imprisoned anti-war and anti-nuclear protesters. The Nuclear Resister has documented over 100,000 anti-war/anti-nuke arrests. Awarded the Nuclear Free Future Foundation 2020 education prize.

before.name: Joyce Hollyday
before.description: Yale Divinity-trained associate editor of Sojourners magazine for 15 years and co-founder of Witness for Peace, the faith-based peace witness in Nicaraguan war zones. Spent multiple weekends in DC jail for protests against U.S. wars in Central America and the nuclear arms race. Author of "Then Shall Your Light Rise" and several other books.
